A Quantitative Study of the Reader's Eye: The Reception of Haruki Murakami's Four Works in Amazon Reviews in relation to the Structure of the Works

Tags: Haruki-Murakami, Reader-Response, correspondence-analy

Maridith @maridithbaker #1 2022-07-03 04:42 UTC

Speaker: Toshihiko Kubota

Affiliation: Meiji University, Tokyo

Title : A Quantitative Study of the Reader’s Eye: The Reception of Haruki Murakami’s Four Works in Amazon Reviews in relation to the Structure of the Works

Abstract : This study uses multivariate analysis (mainly correspondence analysis) to analyze both readers’ reviews and the structure of the works they reviewed, in order to quantitatively reveal where readers’ focus is directed within the works.
